pluginDesc: Sync WeRead books, highlights and notes into SiYuan

login.title: Sign in to WeRead
login.desc: Scan the QR code below with WeChat to sign in
login.otpDesc: This sign-in needs extra verification. Enter the code sent to your WeChat or phone
login.otpExpired: Code expired, please request a new one
login.logoutConfirm: Signing out clears local credentials. Already synced notes are unaffected. Continue?
login.cookieFallback: QR code not working? Paste Cookie manually
login.cookieDesc: Sign in at weread.qq.com in your browser, open DevTools Network panel, copy the Cookie value of any request and paste it below.
login.cookiePlaceholder: Paste Cookie here, e.g. wr_vid=xxx; wr_skey=xxx; ...
login.credExpired: Session expired, please sign in again

dock.title: WeRead
dock.searchPlaceholder: Search title, author, highlight or note…
dock.noBooks: No books yet, click "Sync all" to start
dock.insertFailed: Insert failed, make sure the cursor is in a document
dock.mobileReadonly: Mobile supports viewing only, use desktop to sync and insert

sync.title: Syncing
sync.report: Added {added} · Updated {updated} · Conflicts {conflict} · Deleted remotely {deleted} · Failed {failed}
sync.forceRebuildWarn: This discards ALL your edits in these documents and regenerates them from current WeRead content. This cannot be undone. Continue?
sync.noLogin: Please sign in to WeRead first
sync.interrupted: Sync interrupted, completed part is saved, run sync again to resume

search.title: Insert WeRead note
search.placeholder: Search title, author, highlight or note…

setting.title: Settings
setting.notebookDesc: Synced notes are written to this notebook
setting.autoSyncDesc: Sync automatically once a day (off by default)
setting.concurrencyDesc: Currently forced sequential to avoid SiYuan transaction panic; kept for future use
setting.intervalDesc: Milliseconds, higher is safer but slower
setting.slashDesc: Type it in the editor to open note search, comma separated
setting.coverDesc: Download covers locally, insert at the top of each book document, and show in panel
setting.resetStateDesc: Clear local sync records, next sync is treated as first run
setting.resetStateConfirm: After reset the plugin cannot recognise existing note blocks, next sync may create duplicates. Use only for troubleshooting. Continue?
setting.donateNote: Independently developed — thank you for your support!
